propositions: The checker must enforce top-level docs index membership as a separate rule while validating repository-relative markdown links over an explicit maintained-documentation boundary.
Relative markdown links and images outside fenced blocks and inline code must resolve from source directories to any target inside the repository, rejecting targets that escape the repository.

The checker must report deterministic findings including repository-relative source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason for missing targets and escaped repository targets.
Scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, and inline code spans must produce no findings; query strings and fragments must be stripped before file resolution.

The duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve must be replaced with the unified checker API, and docs/documentation-policy.md must document the source boundary and parser behavior.
